changes.evidence: The stage has no #N, so it starts at S1#1 'Heaven's Half Hour', where Cherry, now Matt's investigator, reports on Fisk's campaign funding. The resistance only forms at the end of S1#9 'Straight to Hell', when Murdock recruits Cherry, Kim and other honest officers after Fisk declares martial law. Fisk is still a candidate when Cherry looks into the campaign.

changes.evidence: Stage starts at S1#1: Cherry finds the unmasked Murdock after Foggy's death and later works as his investigator, both S1#1. The resistance against Fisk only begins in S1#9 'Straight to Hell' ('Murdock recruits Cherry, Kim, and other honest police officers to resist Fisk'), so that clause is a later fact on an S1#1 stage. The card lines don't mention the resistance and stay as they are.

changes.evidence: Stage has no #N, so it starts at S1#1 and gives away the season's twist from the first episode. Murdock first works out that Vanessa hired Dex to kill Nelson at the end of S1#8 'Isle of Joy'. The flashback of Vanessa hiring Poindexter to kill Benny Cafaro and Foggy, and Foggy's files proving Red Hook is a free port, both come in S1#9 'Straight to Hell'.

changes.evidence: Stage starts at S1#1 (they meet and kiss in 'Heaven's Half Hour'). The strain comes in S1#7 and S1#8 (Matt finds out Fisk is her client), Heather takes the Mental Health Commissioner job in S1#9 'Straight to Hell', and S1 never shows a breakup: she is still at his hospital bed in S1#9. The breakup is first mentioned in S2#2 'Shoot the Moon', when Vanessa and Glenn talk about 'the latter's break up with Murdock'. So 'goes on to serve Fisk' and 'until they break up' / 'after they split' are later facts on an S1#1 stage.

changes.evidence: In S2#3 'The Scales & The Sword', McCaffrey confronts Fisk 'after Page anonymously sent them a copy of the Charter of the Port of Red Hook' and warns she can revoke the free-port status. She is not yet working to remove him: in S2#4 'Gloves Off' she tells Vanessa she will back Fisk as long as Vanessa is by his side. She only turns on him in S2#6 'Requiem' (pulls her support after Mr. Charles's visit), and she prepares his suspension in S2#7. 'Who is working to remove Fisk' is a later fact, and 'delivers' is wrong, since Karen sends it anonymously.

changes.evidence: Stage starts at S2#1 'The Northern Star', where Mr. Charles walks in on Steverud, has him take a call from de Fontaine, and Steverud pledges support for Fisk. The CIA's interest in enhanced people first comes out in S2#6 'Requiem': Mr. Charles sends men after Jessica Jones, who had turned down his offer, and Jones tells Daredevil that Mr. Charles and the CIA are interested in her and other enhanced individuals. Luke Cage's recruitment is revealed in S2#7.
